title: India's nuclear energy push (consolidated — target restated 3× this month)
summary: India reaffirmed its target of **100 GW nuclear capacity by 2047**, with sub-targets of 5 indigenous SMRs by 2033 and 5 new reactors operationalised this decade.

blocks.content: India reaffirmed its target of **100 GW nuclear capacity by 2047**, with sub-targets of 5 indigenous SMRs by 2033 and 5 new reactors operationalised this decade.

items: **ANUGYAN** (IIT Hyderabad + Crimson Energy Experts) — India's 1st industry-academia Nuclear Technology Orientation Programme; supports growth from ~8.8 GW to 100 GW by 2047
Three-Stage Nuclear Programme: Stage I — natural uranium in PHWRs (→ plutonium); Stage II — Fast Breeder Reactors (use plutonium); Stage III — large-scale thorium utilisation (U-233 from thorium)
Reaffirmed again in PM Modi's Independence Day address (Section 4)

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — 100 GW by 2047 + 5 SMRs by 2033 + 5 new reactors this decade — single consolidated fact set, appears across 3 separate news items this fortnight.
